summary: spark-operator is a Kubernetes component. managing 3 CRD(s): ScheduledSparkApplication, SparkApplication, SparkConnect. deploying 4 workload(s) (spark-operator-webhook, controller-manager, spark-operator-controller, spark-operator-module-controller-manager) with 4 container(s). watching 15 resource type(s). exposing 3 service(s) on ports: 443, 8080. with 10 webhook(s) (3 validating, 4 mutating). protected by 4 network policy/policies. with 1 PodDisruptionBudget(s). runtime dependencies: kubernetes. defining 13 API spec type(s) across 37 struct(s) with 232 total fields. with 410 operator config constants (7 image references). following 1 reconciliation steps across 1 controller(s). reporting 4 status condition types. with 1 ingress route(s). Python k8s client with 14 API call(s). integrates with Prometheus, management relationship via labels/annotations. kustomize overlays: config/certmanager, config/crd, config/default, config/manager, config/overlays/driver-pdb, config/overlays/odh, config/overlays/rhoai, config/overlays/secure-metrics, config/pdb, config/prometheus, config/public, config/rbac, config/spark-rbac, config/webhook.
repository_description: The Kubernetes Operator for Apache Spark aims to make specifying and running Spark applications as easy and idiomatic as running other workloads on Kubernetes. It uses Kubernetes custom resources for specifying, running, and surfacing status of Spark applications.
